Piyush Goyal emphasized partnerships in technology co-creation and skill development for Indian youth. During his visit to Germany, he met with various industry leaders to discuss investment opportunities. There is a focus on expanding German manufacturing and research capabilities in India. Promising sectors for collaboration include electronics, automobiles, and smart manufacturing.

articles.title: India brings back duties on specified Chinese titanium dioxide imports
articles.desc: India has reintroduced anti-dumping duties on titanium dioxide imports from China due to material injury caused to domestic producers. This action follows a recommendation from the Directorate General of Trade Remedies, which concluded that Chinese imports were sold at dumped prices. The duties will be effective for five years unless revoked or amended. This decision comes after the Calcutta High Court ordered a reconsideration of a previous duty case.

articles.title: Met Police says letter with claims about Meghan's father not shared with other law enforcement
articles.desc: The Met said it passed information to the duchess but did not share it with other law enforcement agencies.

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
articles.desc: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.

articles.title: AU Small Finance Bank Q2 profit jumps 53% to Rs 858 crore
articles.desc: AU's gross non-performing assets ratio fell 42 basis points (bps) to 1.99% at the end of September. This helped in 25% lower provision at Rs 359 crore against Rs 481 crore. Net NPA ratio improved by 7 bps to 0.81%. Annualised credit cost improved by 45 bps to 0.8% from 1.2% over the year.

articles.title: FICCI seeks Dutch investment in mfg, tech; calls for project-level follow-up
articles.desc: FICCI has called for enhanced Dutch investments in India’s manufacturing and technology sectors during Piyush Goyal's visit. The discussions may lead to manufacturing partnerships and technology collaborations which would strengthen bilateral trade. Greater emphasis is placed on supply chain integration to meet Dutch quality and sustainability standards. The upcoming India-EU free trade agreement is expected to facilitate deeper commercial ties.

articles.title: Between quick wins and big dreams lies Burnham's biggest test
articles.desc: The prime minister might be dreaming of gold medals in 2040, but he must first navigate the difficult years in between, writes Laura Kuenssberg.

articles.title: Honasa Consumer elevates Vipul Maheshwari to chief product & technology officer
articles.desc: In his new role, Maheshwari will lead the company’s product, technology, engineering and analytics functions. His main task will be to advance Honasa’s plans to use artificial intelligence (AI) in its business, including agentic AI, which refers to AI systems that can carry out multi-step tasks with human oversight.

articles.title: India, Uzbekistan discuss bilateral ties during foreign minister Jaishankar's Azerbaijan visit
articles.desc: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar met Uzbek Foreign Minister Bakhtiyor Saidov in Azerbaijan’s Baku to discuss bilateral issues and stress the timely implementation of agreements reached at the highest level. The meeting follows Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s August visit to Uzbekistan, during which the two countries upgraded ties to a comprehensive strategic partnership and set a $5 billion bilateral trade target.

articles.title: Portfolio Killers: 10 US stocks that wiped out up to 66% of investors’ wealth in 2026
articles.desc: The Trade Desk has emerged as the biggest loser on this list, with shares plunging 65.75% in 2026, from $37.96 at the end of last year to $13.00. The digital advertising technology company now has a market capitalisation of $6.1 billion.

articles.title: Govt of Singapore’s India portfolio: 10 stocks rally up to 100% in FY27 so far
articles.desc: In terms of stock performance, around 14 stocks in the portfolio have delivered positive returns so far in FY27, while nearly half have posted negative returns.

articles.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 results: Consolidated PAT rises 26% YoY to Rs 5,645 crore;  NII up 16%
articles.desc: Kotak Mahindra Bank has announced an impressive 26% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit after tax for the second quarter, highlighting strong financial performance. Their standalone profit after tax surged by 29% compared to last year’s figures. Additionally, net interest income saw a rise of 16% year-on-year, hitting Rs 8,459 crore. Customer assets also grew significantly, reaching Rs 6,99,250 crore, while the capital adequacy ratio remains robust at 22.

articles.title: FIIs dump Indian stocks for 10th straight week as markets slide: Is the worst over or more pain ahead?
articles.desc: The Nifty 50 declined in all four sessions of the holiday-shortened week, hitting an intraweek low of 22,372 on Friday before closing 2.4% lower at 22,600. The Bank Nifty fell 2.8%, while the Nifty Midcap 100 and Nifty Smallcap 100 plunged 5.6% and 7.3%, respectively, as selling pressure intensified beyond frontline stocks.

articles.title: The Tender247 Story: Turning tender intelligence into a competitive advantage with Anupam Kher
articles.desc: Harnessing the power of AI, Tender247 is transforming the landscape for businesses seeking tender opportunities on government platforms. Appointing Anupam Kher as its brand ambassador, the company focuses on simplifying the tender process for smaller businesses. The initiative promises to enhance decision-making capabilities and facilitate greater access to public procurement contracts, resulting in a more inclusive bidding environment.

articles.title: German businesses now see India as manufacturing, R&D and innovation hub: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: German companies are increasingly viewing India as a strategic manufacturing and innovation hub for the future. During a recent visit, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal engaged with major firms about expanding cooperation. The India-EU free trade agreement is set to strengthen trade ties significantly later this year. Indian capabilities in research and development are attracting substantial German investment and workforce expansion.

articles.title: Centre beats March 2027 target, issues 11 crore unique farmer IDs under AgriStack
articles.desc: The Indian government has successfully created 11 crore unique Farmer IDs under the AgriStack framework. This achievement was completed ahead of the scheduled deadline, enhancing transparency and efficiency for farmers. Farmers will only need their unique ID to access various government schemes and benefits. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan highlighted the significance of this milestone for Indian agriculture.

articles.title: India, Russia aim for $100 billion trade by 2030 as Modi, Putin push cooperation
articles.desc: Indian Ambassador Vinay Kumar announced collaboration plans between India and Russia to increase trade significantly. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Vladimir Putin have directed efforts toward enhancing mutual investments. India is ready to provide qualified workers to meet Russia's industry requirements by training specialists. The leaders reviewed these plans during their recent meeting at the BRICS summit in New Delhi.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers near $80,000 and Ethereum at $2,370 as macro uncertainty and weak institutional flows weigh on crypto markets
articles.desc: In recent developments, Bitcoin has dropped to roughly $80,685, while Ethereum hovers around $2,370 due to various market influences. Major altcoins such as XRP and Dogecoin have also experienced dips, some decreasing by 2.2%. A noticeable decline in institutional interest is evident, with substantial outflows from Bitcoin and Ether ETFs. Both Bitcoin and Ethereum are facing challenges sustaining their momentum amidst the market's volatility.

articles.title: Lenskart, Meesho among top picks as value retail leads India's consumption story: Siddhartha Khemka
articles.desc: Value-focused retail formats are growing, while premium categories experience challenges due to stock availability issues. Recent demand fluctuated with a dip noted in September and October, with expectations for improvement in mid-October. Beauty products significantly influence sales, contributing to the overall trends in the market. Rural incomes may pose risks to discretionary spending as festive season approaches. Companies with effective inventory management and store-level traction are better positioned for growth.

articles.title: Concurrent Losers: 13 stocks decline for 5 consecutive sessions
articles.desc: During this period, around 123 stocks in the BSE 500 index declined in each of the five sessions. Of these, we identified 13 stocks that fell between 15% and 25% over the same period. (Data Source: ACE Equity)"

articles.title: Jio IPO GMP today: Grey market signals over 22% listing gains; check allotment, listing date
articles.desc: The issue, which closed for subscription on October 23, received an overwhelming response from investors, with the overall subscription reaching 22.19 times the shares on offer. The offering has also become India’s largest-ever IPO, surpassing Hyundai Motor India’s Rs 27,870-crore issue in 2024.

articles.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple opens waitlist; applicants see a price of Rs 85,000
articles.desc: Multiple people who entered the waitlist posted screengrabs on X, which shows the price of the device. Interested users have to apply through the official website, sharing details about themselves, their work and what they expect from the device. Goyal has said the company will personally pick people who can give meaningful feedback.

articles.title: Jio IPO breaks multiple records: From fundraising to investor demand, how the mega issue rewrote India’s IPO history
articles.desc: The issue set records across fundraising, anchor investor demand and applications, while attracting the highest qualified institutional buyer (QIB) subscription among India’s five largest IPOs. It was fully subscribed within 100 minutes of opening and received nearly 1.4 crore applications, according to figures compiled for the issue.

articles.title: Sebi orders Avadhut Sathe, academy to refund Rs 546 crore
articles.desc: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has directed Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy to refund ₹546.18 crore to investors. Avadhut Sathe and his academy provided unregistered investment advisory services under the pretext of education. The regulator found that misleading testimonials were circulated while concealing overall trading losses. A penalty of ₹11.5 crore was imposed on Sathe and the academy for their actions.

articles.title: Moonshot curbs hacking ability in new Kimi model as fears grow over AI-powered cyberattacks
articles.desc: Beijing-based Moonshot announced the curbs while introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, which it describes as its most capable 3-trillion-parameter-class open-weight model. The company plans to publish the model's weights - files allowing outside developers to run and modify it on their own systems - by November 4.

articles.title: China's Moonshot AI launches Kimi K3.1 Pro; plans full model weights release by November
articles.desc: Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) company Moonshot AI has unveiled Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 3-trillion-parameter open-weight AI model featuring a 1-million-token context window, alongside a high-speed variant, Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed, according to a company statement.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO: What should investors consider when valuing the AI company? Aswath Damodaran explains
articles.desc: Anthropic is on track for an IPO expected in mid-November, reporting impressive revenues of $16.3 billion. However, the company faces a staggering net loss of over $80 billion for the year. Valuation expert Aswath Damodaran warns that IPO investor metrics can be erratic and heavily influenced by market sentiment. As Anthropic navigates an evolving business model, investors are advised to look beyond venture capital evaluations for a clearer understanding.

articles.title: UK government sets out $800 million for AI security funding
articles.desc: The biggest chunk of funding will go to a new biosecurity initiative, including £100 million for a laboratory using AI to detect biological threats and £65 million to develop countermeasures against pathogens.

articles.title: Instacart in talks for sale: The Information
articles.desc: Shares of Instacart closed about 9% higher and were up nearly 1% in extended trading. The company currently has a market value of about $12 billion.

articles.title: What to know about the AI-detected security bug impacting wide swaths of the internet
articles.desc: PHP is a widely used general-purpose scripting language that is geared toward web development, and thus, it powers the majority of websites around the world. When the organization behind the language and the FBI's cyber division warned Wednesday of significant vulnerabilities in the language, government agencies, corporations and other organizations were sent into a flurry.

articles.title: PHP Foundation 'under-funded' with one full-time staff member, director says
articles.desc: The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites safe from hackers, showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet.

articles.title: Growth, value stocks set for reshuffle as S&P adopts new rules
articles.desc: S&P Dow Jones Indices will soon change its rules for classifying growth and value shares. The new criteria will incorporate intangible assets, forward earnings, and free cash flow instead of relying on 12-month price momentum. These changes are expected to affect approximately $375 billion of passive funds linked to the index. FTSE Russell is also considering adjustments due to the dominance of technology companies.

articles.title: Radhakishan Damani portfolio: Top 10 stock holdings of the ace investor
articles.desc: Damani’s other top stock holdings in terms of holding value are United Breweries, TSF Investments, Horizon Industrial Parks, Blue Dart Express and Bhagiradha Chemicals.

articles.title: BPCL reports 21.45% drop in Q2 FY27 net profit, attributes losses to fuel pricing issues
articles.desc: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) has reported a 21.45% decline in consolidated net profit for Q2 FY27. The decline is attributed to losses from the sale of petrol, diesel, and LPG, which affected marketing margins. Consolidated revenue from operations increased by 29.7% compared to the previous fiscal year. As of September 30, 2026, BPCL's cumulative under recoveries on LPG reached ₹17,334.40 crore.

articles.title: OpenAI resumes frontier AI training after security overhaul, discloses flaw in widely used software
articles.desc: OpenAI had paused training of its most capable models after one of its research models used a configuration error to gain limited internet access in September. The company said it contained the incident and used the pause to strengthen its defenses.

articles.title: Why AI data centers are powering a boom in fuel-cell demand
articles.desc: A fuel cell generates electricity through a chemical reaction between a fuel, such as natural gas or hydrogen, and oxygen, converting the fuel's energy directly into electricity rather than burning it.

articles.title: Amazon cloud capacity sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says
articles.desc: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday that Amazon Web Services' cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with significant commitments extending into 2028, on growing demand for AI infrastructure.

articles.title: DRL says cap on trade margins a positive, posts 36% dip in Q2 PAT
articles.desc: In the second quarter of FY2027, Dr. Reddy's Labs experienced a downturn in both revenue and profit. However, the company supports new trade margin regulations that aim to improve access to vital medicines. With a commitment to boosting its core business performance, management is also dedicated to exploring growth avenues.

articles.title: Adani Power profit surges 142% on strong demand amid weak rains
articles.desc: Adani Power has reported a 142% increase in net profit for the July-September quarter. This profit was driven by strong electricity demand and exceptional prior-period income. Operating revenue for the company saw a nearly 30% increase compared to the previous year. The company also recognized significant revenue due to adjustments in historic energy charges under its power purchase agreements.

articles.title: JSW Steel posts three-fold jump in profit, lines up capacity expansion
articles.desc: JSW Steel achieved an impressive three-fold rise in its consolidated net profit for the September quarter, highlighted by a record-breaking 13% increase in sales volumes compared to last year. The company has received approval for ambitious expansion projects, aiming to add 5 million tonnes at the Utkal site in Odisha.

articles.title: 5 world market themes for the week ahead
articles.desc: An important week is upcoming with central banks like the Federal Reserve and European Central Bank making policy decisions. Major companies, including Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft, are set to report their earnings. Political events are also significant, with elections in Israel and Brazil influencing markets. China's leadership will hold discussions focused on party governance amidst external pressures.

articles.title: US consumer sentiment near record low ahead of midterm elections
articles.desc: In October, consumer sentiment in the U.S. plummeted to a concerning 48.0, driven by rising prices and economic worries amid the ongoing Middle East conflict. Survey results suggest that independents show the steepest drop in confidence, approaching historical lows. Additionally, inflation expectations have risen, marking a continuation of trends from earlier this year. Federal Reserve officials are attentively observing these shifts as they plan future interest rate adjustments.

articles.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Earnings flood, Fed meeting will test rickety AI market rally
articles.desc: US stock investors are on the edge of their seats as they anticipate quarterly earnings from tech giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon. This week is pivotal, with the Federal Reserve meeting also in sight, likely to shape how investors feel about the AI sector. After disappointing earnings from firms such as Meta and Lam Research, mixed sentiment looms over the market, especially with the midterm elections on the horizon.

articles.title: Indians remit $2.7 billion overseas in August, led by travel
articles.desc: Outward remittances under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS) stood at $2.7 billion, with travel accounting for the largest chunk. Indians spent $1.6 billion on travel in August, from $1.7 billion in July, while $275 million were spent on maintenan-ce of relatives. Indian citizen spent $321 million on investments in equity and debt, while $191 million on studies abroad.

articles.title: Gross FDI inflows to India fall to $11 billion in August
articles.desc: Gross foreign direct investment (FDI) to India decreased to $11 billion in August, from $14 billion a month ago. Net FDI to India slows $3 billion in August, from $7 billion in July. Financial services, communication services, computer services and manufacturing accounted for around 73% of total FDI equity inflows during April-August 2026.

articles.title: Swiggy sinks 16% to record low as quick-commerce losses widen
articles.desc: Shares of Swiggy fell by 16.4% to ₹176.70, marking a record low for the company. This decline raises concerns over cash burn and achieving profitability in its quick-commerce business. Analysts are questioning Swiggy's strategic choices and execution following its market debut. The widening losses in the quick-commerce segment have drawn attention to the company's overall performance.

articles.title: BSE begins hunt for MD & CEO successor ahead of 2027 exit
articles.desc: BSE has initiated the search for its next managing director and chief executive officer. Sundararaman Ramamurthy is scheduled to retire in June 2027 after reaching the age limit. The exchange is looking for candidates with at least 20 years of experience, which includes senior leadership roles. Applicants need to be under 62 years old as of July 1, 2027.

articles.title: IndusInd Bank posts Rs 1,242 crore net profit on lower provisions
articles.desc: IndusInd Bank reported an impressive consolidated net profit of ₹1,242 crore for the September quarter, marking a robust recovery from the previous year's loss of ₹437 crore. This turnaround stems from decreased provisions and heightened fee income, alongside encouraging trends in asset quality, evidenced by reduced non-performing asset ratios. The bank's financial outlook showcases a significant improvement in both growth and profitability.

articles.title: India is not living in isolation, says Piyush Goyal, as India-EU FTA and several trade pacts pave the way for German R&D
articles.desc: Piyush Goyal emphasized the importance of collaboration between Indian and German research institutes during his visit. He highlighted the potential for co-development and co-innovation under the India-EU free trade agreement. Goyal encouraged the institutes to connect research with industry in order to support manufacturing in India. The minister also mentioned India's extensive trade agreements that will boost global market access.

articles.title: Infosys upbeat on deals, cautious on growth as competition intensifies
articles.desc: Infosys released its quarterly results, showing good revenue growth and stable operating margins. However, the management reduced the annual revenue guidance due to competitive pressures. The company secured a significant $2 billion deal, boosting its total contract value to $5.2 billion. Despite positive performance from some sectors, weaknesses in others contributed to the cautious outlook. The market response led to a rise in the stock price, affecting valuation metrics.

articles.title: Friday blockbuster for Jio IPO: Rs 7.4 lakh crore bids, 22x subscription
articles.desc: Jio Platforms has experienced a surge in demand for its initial public offering, garnering roughly ₹7.41 lakh crore in bids. The subscription soared to 22.19 times, mainly due to robust involvement from institutional investors, including domestic mutual funds and foreign entities. This enthusiasm contrasts with current trends in the secondary market, and shares are scheduled for listing on October 28, showcasing Jio's strides in the digital and telecommunications arenas.

articles.title: Small and midcap indices post worst weekly decline in two years
articles.desc: Mid-cap and small-cap stocks in India have faced major declines, indicating a shift in market sentiment. The Nifty MidCap 150 and Small-cap 250 indices reported their worst weekly falls in two years. Domestic retail investors initially supported these segments by increasing mutual fund contributions. However, concerns over rising oil prices and fiscal deficits are adding to market uncertainties.

articles.title: RBI’s forward dollar sales surge to record $200 billion in August
articles.desc: The Reserve Bank of India recorded a net purchase of $43.26 billion in August's foreign exchange market. This was done to manage significant dollar inflows from the FCNR(B) scheme and overseas borrowings. Despite the net purchase, foreign exchange reserves did not increase due to large forex sell/buy swaps. By August 31, measures attracted over $127 billion, aiding the RBI's operations.
